prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are helping a {{role}} prepare a weekly management briefing for non-technical stakeholders.
Create an executive summary from the provided performance data using clear, concise language.
Your summary must emphasize decision-making implications for a {{role}}, not technical details.
checklist: Report the top three findings with business impact for the {{role}}.
Highlight one important risk and explain why it matters.
Compare current week vs previous week using concrete metrics.
Keep the final summary short, practical, and ready for leadership review.
